title: Cactus in a pot with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Pot -->
  <path d='M28 68 L32 90 L68 90 L72 68 Z' fill='#E07030' stroke='#F09050' stroke-width='2'/>
  <rect x='25' y='62' width='50' height='8' rx='2' fill='#F08040' stroke='#F0A060' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Cactus body -->
  <rect x='38' y='22' width='24' height='44' rx='12' fill='#3CA040' stroke='#60C060' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Left arm -->
  <path d='M38 42 Q26 42 26 34 Q26 26 32 26' fill='none' stroke='#3CA040' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M38 42 Q26 42 26 34 Q26 26 32 26' fill='none' stroke='#60C060' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Right arm -->
  <path d='M62 50 Q76 50 76 42 Q76 34 70 34' fill='none' stroke='#3CA040' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 50 Q76 50 76 42 Q76 34 70 34' fill='none' stroke='#60C060' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Spine dots -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='30' r='1.2' fill='#A0E080'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='30' r='1.2' fill='#A0E080'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='24' r='1.2' fill='#A0E080'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='38' r='1.2' fill='#A0E080'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='38' r='1.2' fill='#A0E080'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='56' r='1.2' fill='#A0E080'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='56' r='1.2' fill='#A0E080'/>
  <!-- Flower on top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='4' fill='#FF6090'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='16' r='2.5' fill='#FF80A0'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='16' r='2.5' fill='#FF80A0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='15' r='2' fill='#FFD040'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='48' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#F0F8E0'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='48' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#F0F8E0'/>
  <circle cx='44.5' cy='48.5' r='1.8' fill='#205010'/>
  <circle cx='56.5' cy='48.5' r='1.8' fill='#205010'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='54' r='2.5' fill='#FF8080' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='54' r='2.5' fill='#FF8080' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M43 54 Q50 61 57 54' fill='none' stroke='#E8F8D0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
